mentions.name: Automated LoRa Irrigation & Fertigation System
mentions.description: Automated irrigation and fertigation system for crops in India that remotely switches solenoid valves for drip or flood irrigation, using LoRa protocol as the communication medium between sensors and the main unit; still in the research phase pending a prototype.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on automated irrigation and fertigation system where remotely we can turn on of the solenoid valve to drip/flood irrigate crops in India. I am using LORA protocol for communication medium between different sensor and main unit. I am still researching on this.

evidence.value: I am working on automated irrigation and fertigation system where remotely we can turn on of the solenoid valve to drip/flood irrigate crops in India. I am using LORA protocol for communication medium between different sensor and main unit. I am still researching on this.
